create_MLP: create a feed-forward MLP with configurable input, hidden, output dimensions and layer count
build_MLP_network: build a multi-layer perceptron with ReLU activations on all but the last layer
test_MLP_forward: test the MLP forward pass by passing a tensor through the network layers
review_MLP_init: review the MLP constructor to understand how linear layers are built dynamically
refactor_MLP_layers: refactor the MLP to add dropout or batch normalization between layers
